capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Lexus USA 2026 RZ release lists 74.7 (printed as "kW"; Cars.com reads kWh); gross vs usable not stated.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for the 74.7 kWh pack (bZ4X Touring AWD MY26, European listing); Lexus states total only; same pack as the Toyota/Subaru twins (Cars.com).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Toyota chief engineer (Autopian): the 74.7 kWh pack keeps the same NMC chemistry and cells; Cars.com says the RZ 350e/450e carries the same 74.7 kWh as its Toyota and Subaru counterparts; the 550e pack is 76.96 kWh of the same TNGA-K family.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Toyota chief engineer (InsideEVs): the 74.7 kWh bZ "still runs on a 400-volt electrical architecture"; the RZ shares that pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Lexus ES release (2026, same maker and TNGA-K lineup): Battery Preconditioning from the touchscreen or automatically with a charger as destination; Motor1 confirms the 2026 RZ gains preconditioning. No RZ page describes the trigger.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lexus USA: 11-kW on-board AC charger, up from 7 kW.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Lexus gives no peak kW for the RZ; the 74.7 kWh bZ sibling is capped at 150 kW per Toyota chief engineer (InsideEVs); Lexus 10-80% in about 30 min is consistent. No page differentiates the 2026 trims.

published_10_80_min.notes: "around 30 minutes" 10-80% under ideal conditions; model-level claim.
